subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase the open fork PR at https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/1175, or close it and queue a fresh OpenClaw-side fix for the same cron minute-field bug?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrowly owned, but a linked open fork PR already claims the fix and is based on older stagger code, so automation should not start a competing repair until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Review and adopt the linked PR
options.body: Rebase it onto current main, preserve `hasRecurringWildcardHour`, require focused proof, and land if the patch remains correct.

options.title: Close the linked PR and queue replacement
options.body: If the fork PR is not worth adopting, close it with rationale and allow one fresh narrow fix PR against current main.

recommendation.title: Review and adopt the linked PR
recommendation.body: Rebase it onto current main, preserve `hasRecurringWildcardHour`, require focused proof, and land if the patch remains correct.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed the same helper and tests for a related top-of-hour stagger invariant.
